virality_data.topic: Why we rewrote our internal developer CLI from Python to Rust
virality_data.analysis: The 'rewrite it in Rust' narrative remains incredibly potent on Medium, especially when backed by shocking performance metrics (e.g., 10,000x speedups). This post dives into the architectural friction of Python's startup latency and dependency hell in local developer environments. It provides concrete before-and-after code comparisons to justify the rewrite.

Hacker News: Constant debate on the real-world utility of rewriting tools in Rust
virality_data.story_angle: Our local build steps were lagging, so I spent a weekend porting our version bump script to Rust and accidentally eliminated all startup latency.
